scope: 100 user-provided USPs preserved without treating brainstormed features as delivered
ownership: Human sketch masters, AI-assisted variants, and founder approval
customer_promise: Only shipped and evidenced capabilities can appear as live promises
commercial_priority: Deploy correct storefront, prove one independent paid order and delivery before expanding paid avatar catalogue
claim_rules: No unverified price-premium statistics or 2026 best-seller ranks
No first/only/human-certified claim without independent evidence
Hand drawn and human-created claims require original sketch hash, artist license and human approval
AI enhanced not AI generated refers to verified original sketch inputs; never infer authorship from line wobble
No sales or royalties promised without actual payments and agreements
No sensitive photo upload, deleted-data or air-gap claims without actual system proof
Copyright, cultural rights, consumer-law and accessibility reviews required
